Strategy: Wide awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and the full item score far lower, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that wider awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by avoiding more leftovers too small for a repeat item, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 100.0 if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Wide awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, item] by 100, exact fit highest, else Best Fit.
